method: Procedural Blender modeling from dimensioned primitives and custom meshes
sourceImageRole: Visual proportion and equipment-detail reference only; no geometry or texture was reconstructed from it
authorship: Original unbranded procedural geometry authored for LUCA-AI

parts: rear three-point hitch, PTO and hydraulic cylinders
engine block, sump, fuel tank and pivoting front axle
CavityAO and height-based dry-earth vertex colour

materials: Two consolidated PBR material families with CavityAO/colour per vertex; no image textures and no manufacturer marks
limitations: The model is a visual simulator asset, not a manufacturer-accurate CAD assembly
Hydraulic hoses are simplified to keep the runtime draw and triangle budget predictable
Cab glazing is opaque tinted glass so body surfaces can share one runtime draw
Dust and crevice occlusion are baked into the CavityAO vertex colour channel rather than an image atlas
